description: Identity-connect binding boundaries. With identity-connect enabled but NO scope requested, a successful authorization issues a code with NO bound identity assertion (issued.identity_token=absent), contrasting the present-binding case. With identity-connect DISABLED (default), requesting the 'openid' scope is treated as an ordinary scope and again binds no identity assertion.
